source.description:
PROBLEM: The .12 accumulation fix is bypassed on the opencode-go/muse-spark-1.3-contributor route. Two specialist_status polls 65s apart on live run act:7e5baa87-c42 show snapshot token_usage DECREASING: input_tokens 293->206, output_tokens 739->204, reasoning_tokens 496->0, while cache_read grew 49649->51313. Monotonic accumulation can never decrease, so the snapshot is being spread-merged with latest per-message values on this run's event path. Operator-visible symptom: row spend stuck/jumping (reported as "49k" + blinking) -- each message visibly replaces the total instead of adding to it.

SUCCESS: Successive polls on any provider route show non-decreasing input/output/reasoning/cache totals; row spend climbs monotonically and never jumps down.

SCOPE: Snapshot usage write path in native-host.ts for event shapes this route emits. Suspect: usage arrives on an event type other than the message_end branch .12 fixed (or a second writer -- liveStats/forensic merge -- still spread-merges and the view reads it). Compare against the .12 accumulation test's synthetic events vs this provider's real event stream (capture event types seen during the run).

NON_GOALS: Row rendering; formatSpendShort; legacy short-key shapes (crjh7 done).

CONSTRAINTS: No added latency on the dispatch path; accumulation stays message_end-or-equivalent, never per-tick bd.

VALIDATION: Live multi-message run polls monotonic; unit test with the real event shape from this route.

OUTPUT: Fix + regression test in bead notes.

SCRUTINY: low
source.notes:
SECOND SYMPTOM 2026-09-09 (act:10e9333c-983, Spark route): row shows 990k after ~130s -- impossible as real spend. Refines the mechanism: if this route's message_end usage is CUMULATIVE-per-message (not deltas), the .12 sum-accumulation double/triple-counts every message and explodes. Fix must handle both shapes: accumulate deltas where per-message, take-latest where cumulative (distinguish by monotonic per-message growth vs reset pattern), never sum blindly.
Fix on branch fix/unitAI-beqby.15-spend-flap. Root cause: blind per-key summing (beqby.12) is correct for delta-shape message_end usage but explodes on cumulative-per-message counters (990k symptom); the pre-.12 spread-replace explains the decreasing polls (293->206). Fix: shared accumulateTokenUsage() in native-activation-observability.ts decides per MESSAGE -- cumulative only when every carried counter with history grew, else the whole message adds whole; zeros skipped. Wired into native-host.ts onSessionEvent (WeakMap lastSeen per snapshot, survives resume) and forensic-sink.ts sessionEvent (replaces the plain assignment second writer). Known ceiling: all-growing delta message reads as cumulative (slight undercount, never flap/explode). Tests: host .15 replay of both Spark symptoms + sink accumulation test; .12 test intact; vitest 32/32, tsc clean.
source.title: Spend flap returns on Spark route: snapshot usage decreases between polls
